message lgtm.link.v1.LookAtFolder
  1 operation_id string
  2 path string
message lgtm.link.v1.FolderSeen
  1 operation_id string
  2 command_id string
  3 facts lgtm.link.v1.FolderFacts oneof=result
  4 refusal lgtm.link.v1.FolderRefusal oneof=result
message lgtm.link.v1.FolderFacts
  1 resolved_path string
  2 name string
  3 main_branch string
  4 checked_out_branch string optional
  5 remote string optional
  6 first_commit string optional
  7 clean bool
  8 remote_omitted bool
enum lgtm.link.v1.FolderRefusal
  0 FOLDER_REFUSAL_UNSPECIFIED
  1 FOLDER_REFUSAL_NOT_A_FOLDER
  2 FOLDER_REFUSAL_NOT_A_GIT_REPOSITORY
  3 FOLDER_REFUSAL_NOT_READABLE
  4 FOLDER_REFUSAL_PATH_NOT_USABLE
